definitions.explanation: Happening or progressing at a fast rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急速|きゅうそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}している→発展する：03561_hatten⟧。
{急速|きゅうそく}⟦な→な：03496_na⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げた→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧。
⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急速|きゅうそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The aging of the population is progressing rapidly.

notes:
{急速|きゅうそく} is a na-adjective emphasizing the speed at which change or progress occurs. Often used for large-scale phenomena.

FORMS:
- {急速|きゅうそく}な: rapid (attributive)
- {急速|きゅうそく}に: rapidly (adverbial)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {急速|きゅうそく}な{発展|はってん}: rapid development
- {急速|きゅうそく}に{進|すす}む: to progress rapidly
- {急速|きゅうそく}に{広|ひろ}がる: to spread rapidly
- {急速|きゅうそく}な{変化|へんか}: rapid change

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {急激|きゅうげき}: drastic (emphasizes intensity and suddenness)
- {高速|こうそく}: high-speed (for physical speed)
- {迅速|じんそく}: swift, prompt (for taking action quickly)
- {急速|きゅうそく} focuses on the pace of change over time
